allocations.rationale: Directly resolves requirement 1 by extracting patient-by-patient numerators, denominators, and specific HPO terms from primary tables in Calame et al. (2023).
Directly resolves requirement 2 by identifying discriminating clinical phenotypes (such as CMT2 axonal neuropathy and cardiomyopathy) separating DHX9 from its chief differential, DHX30.
